project_type: Kiro skills/steering workspace for .NET modernization playbook
verification_instructions: Manual review - ensure all files are renamed/updated correctly, no broken references, consistent terminology
environment_constraints: No build system needed. Git available. Internet access available.
contribution_requirements: Work on a feature branch. Commit changes.
key_patterns: Skills have SKILL.md with frontmatter (name, description) and a ## Workflow section. Steering files have YAML frontmatter with inclusion type (always or fileMatch). Working folder uses {CUSTOMER} placeholder. Hooks are JSON files in .kiro/hooks/.
directory_structure: .kiro/skills/ - 6 skills each with SKILL.md and optional references/ subfolder. .kiro/steering/ - 5 steering files. .kiro/hooks/ - 3 hooks (to be removed). working/ - per-customer work folders with sample data.
